name: get_digital_alternative
description: Map what the caller wants to do onto the digital or doorstep services that remove the need for a counter visit — Post App, digital stamps, E-Post, online redirection, eBill, My Post 24 and the home service. Use it when the errand itself can be done without travelling, which is often a better answer than an address two villages away. RETURNS { found, intent, services }, each service with name, channel, url, replaces_counter_visit and a description in the caller's language, best option first. Offer the first one once. If the caller says they want a counter, or that they do not use apps, drop it and give them a location instead.

request_body_schema.description: Digital or doorstep alternatives for what the caller wants to do.

properties.description: What the caller is trying to do. One of: send_letter, send_parcel, receive_parcel, track_shipment, pay_bill, redirect_mail, hold_mail, buy_stamps, collect_registered, cash_withdrawal, change_address.
The language the caller is speaking, as a two-letter code: 'de', 'fr', 'it' or 'en'. Location names, service labels, status labels and holiday names come back in it.
